name: Email
description: Email authority — governs sending, drafting, and reading email via Gmail
whatsNew: This area now says what kind of value each sealed field is — recipients are lists, subject and text are text, attachments are files — so anyone checking an email on its ticket page can drop in the attached file instead of typing its fingerprint. Limits and sealed content are unchanged.

send_daily_max.description: Maximum emails sent or drafted per day

read_max_age_days.description: Maximum age in days for email search. Enforced locally by the Gatekeeper, never by the Authority Server: reads carry no ticket, so no signed check ever reads this value. Set it on the integration instead, where it is live-editable. Kept in the schema as the fallback for grants issued before that setting existed.

read_access.description: Allow the agent to list and read messages in the mailbox (simulated or real). Sending is governed separately.

setup_daily_max.description: How many times per day the simulated system may be loaded with a simulation package (load_simulation). Only works while the connector runs in simulation mode, and only into an empty system — a load cannot edit or replace existing test data. 0 = not allowed. Grant it only in a separate setup mandate, never in the mandate the AI uses for its work.

allowed_recipients.description: Comma-separated list of allowed email addresses

allowed_domains.description: Comma-separated list of allowed recipient domains (e.g. acme.com,partner.org)

allowed_attachment_sources.description: Comma-separated list of document sources this mandate may attach, as connector:kind (e.g. erp:invoice-pdf,erp:credit-note-pdf). Empty = no attachments. The gateway fetches each attached document itself; the AI only names it.

recipient_count.description: Number of recipients in this email

allowed_recipients.description: Comma-separated recipient addresses from this call (checked against context)

allowed_domains.description: Comma-separated unique recipient domains from this call (checked against context)

send_count_daily.description: Running daily send/draft count (resolved from execution log)

setup_count_daily.description: Running daily count of test-data loads

allowed_attachment_sources.description: Comma-separated connector:kind sources of this call's attachments (checked against scope; absent when the email has none)
